prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1337; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound through the signalized intersection in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on its driver side by Driver 2, whose vehicle was southbound and entered the intersection on a steady red signal. The point of impact and the resulting intrusion into the driver door are consistent with a broadside collision at the speeds reported by both drivers. Driver 1 reported a concussion and was transported for evaluation. Officers on scene confirmed that Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel at the time of the collision, and a passenger in the front seat was also identified. Driver 2 acknowledged the signal violation and did not dispute the sequence of events described by Driver 1. Two independent witnesses gave statements that matched this account, and scene photographs show damage patterns that align with the reported impact. Officers found no indication of prior damage to the vehicle in the areas affected. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
